text:
ryan-cs: Customer (AcmeMedia) reporting console '403 permission denied' when switching projects using a service account key. Started after the org role-freeze deploy earlier today. Steps customer gave: sign in with service token -> open Console -> click project dropdown -> select project -> 403. They can list projects via API but console blocks.

andre: Can you paste the exact error payload from the browser console / network? Is it a 403 from our API or from the frontend auth check?

ryan-cs: Frontend shows generic 403 overlay. Network XHR to /api/console/switch returned 403 with body: ```{
  \"error\": \"permission_denied\",
  \"reason\": \"missing_project_access\"
}``` Headers included `x-request-id: r-9f7b3` and `www-authenticate: Bearer realm=\"redwood\"`.

support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-2026-4591 for AcmeMedia. Assigned to eng-sre. :ticket:

maya: Important detail — you said they can list projects via API. Do they use the same service account credentials for list vs console actions? Could be a scope or impersonation difference.

ryan-cs: They used a JSON key (SA key) to call list projects: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects` -> works. Console action is a POST to /api/console/switch with `x-service-account: sa-acmemedia-01` header from frontend.

tessa: Asking infra: we rolled out a new "role-freeze" feature that prevents role mutations during org migrations; it also toggles a flag on service accounts created before migration. There was a bug where the flag caused our console auth layer to treat the SA as "frozen" and remove UI-level project grants while API introspection still returned cached grants.

andre: If that's true, workaround is to regenerate a new SA key (new key won't have the frozen flag) or temporarily flip the freeze flag off for that org. Which one does support want to do?

ryan-cs: Customer prefers not to rotate keys mid-day. Can we do a console-side temporary bypass for UI switching? Even a grant escalate would help.

ops-bot: @andre rolled back config toggle on staging yesterday; prod toggle still on for org 0xACM. Current prod state: role_freeze_enabled=true for org 0xACM.

tessa: Quick mitigation I can run: set `role_freeze_enabled=false` scoped to the org for 10 minutes so the console auth check re-evaluates grants, then re-enable. That avoids key rotation. I'll coordinate maintenance window with CS.

maya: Also capturing a repro for the team: steps to repro locally -> create SA pre-migration, set role_freeze=true, try `POST /api/console/switch` as that SA; frontend returns 403 but `GET /v1/projects` returns 200. I'll add a unit test for the console auth path.

andre: Root cause summary for the ticket: role-freeze flag inadvertently bypasses UI grant sync path; API list uses grant cache while console relies on live auth-service check which saw the SA as restricted. Fix: ensure console auth path consults grant cache fallback OR fix flag semantics. Hotfix planned to add fallback within 24h, full fix in next release.

ryan-cs: Customer notified and accepted temporary toggle. Please add steps for them to verify once toggle is flipped so we can close SUP-2026-4591.

support-bot: SUP-2026-4591 updated: mitigation scheduled by tessa at 2026-04-02T15:10:00Z. Next steps posted. :white_check_mark:

andre: Quick note: if anyone needs to reproduce headers from the failing request, use this curl: ```bash
curl -i -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/console/switch" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SA_TOKEN>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"project_id":"proj-acm-42"}'
```

ryan-cs: Thanks all. Will confirm with customer after toggle runs. :thumbsup:
